lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs are visible posterior to the gill slits. The column immediately posterior to the pectoral fin insertion contains five distinct local maxima arranged in a near-linear vertical sequence, with neighboring columns showing a staggered, alternating vertical distribution.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the centroids of the circular blobs, forming a discernible grid-like structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank; the primary ridge exhibits a sharp vertical intensity gradient (bright superior edge, shadowed inferior edge) extending from the posterior gill margin toward the caudal region.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible lateral surface of the first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of small, discrete high-luminance blobs, with approximately seven distinct maxima visible within the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A single remora (family Echeneidae) is visible in the lower right quadrant, swimming in close proximity to the shark's ventral-lateral flank below the pectoral fin.
